patterns.note: Content sections are primarily centered and full-width, using a deep dark background, with internal elements often arranged in grids or stacked vertically.
Key headings utilize a large, bold sans-serif font with a vibrant gradient fill, contrasting with smaller, lighter-weight sans-serif body text.
A deep, dark background (#0d1117) serves as the primary canvas, accented by bright, multi-color gradients (teal to blue) for prominent text and interactive elements.
A compact navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access to site navigation.
Feature sections consistently pair a large, gradient-text heading with descriptive text and a visual representation, often a mobile phone mockup showcasing the app's UI.

technique_notes: A dark, almost black background is used across the entire page, creating a high-contrast canvas for lighter text and vibrant accents.
Prominent headings and call-to-action buttons feature a linear gradient fill, transitioning between a bright teal and a vibrant blue, making them visually pop against the dark background.
Mobile phone mockups are strategically placed throughout the page, displaying the app's interface and features in context.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold headings (up to ~4x body text) with gradient fills, paired with a clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and card-like elements, including the phone mockups.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, creating clear visual breaks; content within sections uses a balanced density.

standout: The consistent use of vibrant, multi-color gradients for key headings and call-to-action elements against a deep dark background creates a striking and modern aesthetic that feels energetic and premium for an app.
